observations: Photo 0 shows the top of an engine block with a black plastic cover.
The engine appears to be a 4-cylinder unit with a single overhead cam (SOHC) configuration.
There is visible rust and wear on the metal components.
A multi-colored wiring harness is visible on the right side.
The engine is resting on a concrete surface.
A watermark 'MOUS AUTO PARTS' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.claim: never buy an item because it's cheap

risks.risk: The engine may have internal mechanical damage (e.g., cracked block, seized pistons) not visible from the top.
risks.proof: A video of the engine being tested on a dynamometer or a video of it running.

risks.risk: The engine may have a blown head gasket or coolant leaks.
risks.proof: A video of the engine running with a coolant leak test or a photo of the underside.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring a head gasket replacement

risks.risk: The engine may be missing critical internal components like the timing belt or water pump.
risks.proof: A photo of the engine bay showing the timing belt and water pump.

proof_requests: Photo of the engine identification plate (usually on the side or front of the block).
Photo of the engine bay showing the air intake, battery, and radiator.
Video of the engine running to check for smoke, noise, or oil leaks.
Photo of the underside of the engine to check for coolant leaks.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
